title: Demon
wikitext:
{{Stub}}Hellish, twisted creatures found on the worlds conquered by the [[Burning Legion]].  There are many types (see below) and races, most of whom typically serve either their own agenda or that of the [[Burning Legion|Legion]] (they are often the same). For a description of the most important/famous demons visit the race pages or the [[Burning Legion|Legion page]].

It is not known if there is a difference between the Demons of the Burning Legion and the Daemons of the first two WarCaft games. If we had to pick, these monsters appeared to most closely resemble Doomguard [the Daemon design was essentially abandonded for WarCraft III]. The first named demon encountered by players was Kil'Jaeden in the WarCraft II manual.  [[Kil'jaeden]] resembled the Daemons, but was switched to an Eredar when the command structure and races were finalized.

* '''See also:''' [[Burning Legion]].


=Major Races=
* [[Eredar]] - Highest Rank of the legion. They dont usually engage in combat.
* [[Pit Lord|Pit Lords]] - Generals usually lead armies of the legion.
* [[Nathrezim]] (aka: Dread Lords) - Usually command a small amount of felgaurds - dont always engage in combat and are more like master minds.
* [[Doomguard]] -  Lead dozens of felgaurds into battle. Extrememly powerful and take a dozens of heroes to take down.
* [[Felguard]] - The main infantry of the Legion. Thousands go into battle. They are lethal but inexperienced and are treated poorly.

=Lesser Races=
* [[Imp]]
* [[Succubus]]
* [[Voidwalker]]
